school: Greenwood International School only. Latest year_label is 2024-25.
rules: Only one school exists. Do NOT use WHERE school_name unless the view lists school_name in this catalog.
v_exam_outcomes has NO school_name column.
For trends over all years use v_exam_outcomes GROUP BY year_label ORDER BY year_label without school filter.
Prefer the views below over raw tables.
Current students means enrollment_status = 'ACTIVE'.
Pass and fail use v_exam_outcomes.final_status values Pass and Fail.
Block names are exactly A Block, B Block, C Block, D Block.
House names are Red House, Blue House, Green House, Yellow House.
National sports qualifiers use v_sports_activity.qualification_level = 'National Qualifier'.
If the user does not name a year, filter year_label = '2024-25'.
Return one PostgreSQL SELECT only.
Topper means the highest percentage on v_exam_outcomes for that year_label. Use ORDER BY percentage DESC LIMIT 1 and return student_name and percentage. Do not filter student_name.
Session means year_label. Nth from the bottom means ORDER BY percentage ASC OFFSET (n - 1) LIMIT 1 on v_exam_outcomes for that year_label. Do not invent a name or rank filter.
Bottom, lowest, or worst performer: ORDER BY percentage ASC on v_exam_outcomes.
Do not filter student_name unless the user gives an exact name from prior results.
Top N students for every session/year: use ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY year_label ORDER BY percentage DESC) and filter year_rank <= N.
Progress or trend from school start to now: AVG(percentage) GROUP BY year_label ORDER BY year_label; chart line.
Pass vs fail for one year: COUNT by final_status WHERE year_label = that year; chart pie.
Gender values on students and enrollment views are Male, Female, or Other.
Fee session means year_label on v_student_session_fees or v_student_monthly_fees.
Fee cleared or paid in full: payment_status = 'CLEAR' (dues_amount <= 0). Outstanding fees: payment_status IN ('DUE', 'PARTIAL') or dues_amount > 0.
Monthly fees use billing_month (first day of calendar month, e.g. 2024-06-01).
Daily attendance is v_student_daily_attendance. status is exactly Present, Absent, or Late.
Monthly attendance is v_student_monthly_attendance, rolled up from daily rows. attendance_month is the first day of that month.
attendance_percentage counts Present and Late as attended days. Absent is not attended.
Monthly attendance trend: AVG(attendance_percentage) GROUP BY attendance_month ORDER BY attendance_month on v_student_monthly_attendance for one year_label; chart line.
Sports: use view v_sports_activity. One row per student per sports event.
How many students play sports or sports participation headcount: COUNT(DISTINCT student_name) on v_sports_activity for the year_label — never use COUNT(*) alone for that question.
Participation records or entries per sport: COUNT(*) GROUP BY sport_name on v_sports_activity.
Top N sports by participation: GROUP BY sport_name, order by COUNT(*) DESC, LIMIT N.
Sports vs non-sports students: COUNT(DISTINCT) active enrollments (v_student_enrollment, enrollment_status ACTIVE) who appear in v_sports_activity vs those who do not for the same year_label.

Pass vs fail among sports participants only: restrict to DISTINCT student_name from v_sports_activity for the year, join v_exam_outcomes on student_name and year_label, then COUNT by final_status — not whole-school pass/fail.
Do not answer sports count questions with total active enrollment unless the user asks for all enrolled students.
